subject: general
question: Two people drive towards each other from two places which are 56 km apart. The speed of the first person is 13 km/h and speed of the other is 14 km/h. After how long will they be 2 km apart if they start driving together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance to be covered for the 2 km gap = 56 − 2 = 54 km.

Relative speed in opposite direction = 13 + 14 = 27 kmph.

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 54 ÷ 27 = 2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a17a34345f7d2baa5997b4268d448d14713ae457f1ccecef9c8f4f16f4ca4ff3.png] 

**Given:**

Total distance = 56 km

Speed 1 (S₁) = 13 km/h

Speed 2 (S₂) = 14 km/h

Desired remaining distance = 2 km

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = S₁ + S₂

Time = (Total Distance − Remaining Distance) ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 13 + 14 = 27 km/h

⇒ Distance to be covered = 56 − 2 = 54 km

⇒ Time required = 54 ÷ 27

⇒ Time = 2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.

Meeting Point vs Apart Distance

To find the meeting time, use the total distance. To find the time to be 'x' distance apart before meeting, use (Total Distance − x).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p
